messages:
devon: seeing a spike in 429s and ~15% GPU pod evictions in sfo-1, started at ~18:03 UTC. probing now.

oncall-bot: Incident created (sev2) — SFO egress asymmetry -> gpu eviction cascade. Channel: #incidents (thread 1845009876).

maria: is this the same path-flap we saw last month?

devon: initial signs look similar. external AS path changed abruptly, host NIC reset recorded, then kube started evicting pods due to node conditions. Not a model crash.

samir: I'm going to shift traffic off SFO to give us breathing room. target: AMS + LAX.

devon: copying the command I'm running now:
```
traffic-shift --from sfo --to ams,lax --weights 70,30 --grace 120s --dry-run=false
```

maria: watch autoscaler queues in AMS — pre-warm reserved pool to avoid cold-start queuing. increase prewarm by +20% for the next 30m.

toni: runbook note: the current failover playbook only checks pod health and CPU. it doesn't validate egress BGP neighbor states or NIC resets. we should add a pre-check step.

devon: logs snippet from host where NIC reset happened:
```
Mar 10 18:02:58 node-sfo-113 kernel: e1000e 0000:3b:00.0 NIC Link is Down
Mar 10 18:02:59 node-sfo-113 kernel: vfio-pci 0000:3b:00.1: failed to reset device
Mar 10 18:03:01 kubelet[1234]: evicting pod "inference-xyz" due to NodeReady==false
```

samir: action items (created): INC-1845009876-1 add BGP egress health probe, INC-1845009876-2 add NIC-reset alert -> automated node drain, INC-1845009876-3 run capacity dry-run for AMS prewarm.

toni: also add an explicit rollback/slowdown step in the traffic-shift playbook: if pod eviction rate > 5%/5m, revert 50% of shifted weight and notify oncall.

maria: pinging @eng-networking and @eng-runtime for firmware vendor follow-up. vendor indicates a firmware bug that can cause link flaps when certain ACLs are applied. vendor patch ETA 72h.

devon: temporary mitigation: enable BFD hold-time increase on the SFO egress peers and adjust ACL application windows. Will coordinate with netops.

oncall-bot: action item created: postmortem and playbook update assigned to devon,samir,toni. Due: 2026-03-20.

samir: cost note: shifting ~70% of traffic to AMS increases egress CPU and GPU minutes due to cold starts; expect a ~12% spike on hourly burn during shift. include cost estimate in postmortem.

toni: post-incident playbook changes proposed (short):
- Add 'egress BGP sanity' pre-check.
- Add NIC-reset -> auto-drain + instance replacement step.
- Add throttled weight ramps (max 20%/5m) and a short grace for autoscaler.
- Add vendor-firmware column to known-hardware failures section.

maria: +1 to all. I'll update the runbook doc and link to the incident ticket when done.

devon: ending notes: root cause = egress route flap triggering NIC-level resets (firmware + ACL interaction). Immediate mitigations applied (traffic shift + BFD tweak). Next steps: vendor patch, runbook changes, tabletop dry-run next week.

oncall-bot: Incident 1845009876 marked transitioning -> follow-up.

maria: assigning postmortem write-up to devon. samir and toni will own the playbook and monitoring changes.

devon: will publish a short executive summary for product/sales with impact window and cost delta.

samir: I'll schedule the capacity dry-run for Thursday 09:00 UTC and notify infra oncall.

toni: adding a short checklist to the playbook: `preflight: bgp-check, egress-probe, prewarm-capacity` and a template rollback command.

maria: thanks all. moving thread to follow-up and closing active mitigation.

devon: closing thread here, will attach postmortem once draft is ready.
